entities.name: amending
entities.details: City Commission approved amending the St. Philip’s School site plan under Ordinance No. 3576 to include a new pre-K building at 1109 Andalusia Avenue, Coral Gables, Florida; all other conditions of approval contained in Ordinance No. 3576 shall remain in effect.

entities.name: replace
entities.details: The existing building at 1109 Andalusia Avenue, Coral Gables, Florida, was approved to be replaced with a new pre-K building as part of the site plan amendment under Ordinance No. 3576.

entities.name: remain in effect
entities.details: All other conditions of approval contained in Ordinance No. 3576 shall remain in effect following the amendment.

entities.name: sworn in
entities.details: City officials and public speakers participated in the swearing-in ceremony during the City Commission Meeting.

entities.name: stand and raise your right hand
entities.details: Participants stood and raised their right hand during the oath-taking segment of the meeting.

entities.name: swear or affirm
entities.details: City officials and speakers swore or affirmed their oaths during the meeting.
